title: Solo Aging, Sci-Fi Albums, and Everything
content:
No AI summaries here, just thoughtful and curious people helping other thoughtful and curious people.

How Do You Set Yourself Up for Solo Aging Success? If you're aging without a partner or kids, you're not alone in being alone. In this refreshingly candid thread, a user asks for help planning a secure and happy future as a solo ager, and the responses are full of wisdom and heartfelt advice.

What Are Your Favorite Sci-Fi Albums? Need a soundtrack for imagining distant futures, spacefaring epics, or just the right vibes? This thread has personal recommendations that range from retro synthwave to ambient space odysseys. There's some you've probably never heard of, and some you'll want to queue up immediately!

Everything, Everywhere, All in One Thread Curious about what the other 8 billion people on the planet are doing? This check out this live-ish estimate of everyone is doing, based on global population dynamics & simulated day/night cycles. Who knew so many of y'all were on smoke breaks?!
author: Brandon Blatcher
